messages:
Maya: Postmortem follow-up: we agreed on alert-tuning work to reduce recurring pager noise. Need owners + clear success metrics. Short thread to capture owners and due dates.

Maya: Items: 1) noisy exporter alerts at night, 2) prediction-service memory flaps, 3) dedupe identical DB errors across AZs, 4) paging policy adjustments for low-impact routes.

Diego: I'll own exporter noise (item 1). Plan: run 30d hourly histogram, add suppression window 23:00-06:00 UTC, and remove two noisy alert labels. Target: 2026-04-04. Will attach CSV.

Nina: I can take prediction-service thresholds (item 2). Steps: extract 14d RSS/GC/OOM events, propose conservative + aggressive thresholds, create staging alerts, 72h canary, then promote. Target: 2026-03-30.

Ethan: I'll own dedupe cross-AZ (item 3) and paging-policy draft (item 4). Dedupe prototype: signature = sha1(service + error_class + short_stack) window=20m. I'll also add a rule: when dedupe suppresses >50% of pages for an alert, auto-unmute and surface to #eng-oncall for review. Target: 2026-04-08.

Maya: Good. Ops-bot, please create a ticket with checklist and due dates and add acceptance metrics: nightly_pager_count, unique_alert_signatures, median_time_to_silence.

ops-bot: Created INFR-4681 assigned to <@Diego>, <@Nina>, <@Ethan>. Due dates: Diego 2026-04-04, Nina 2026-03-30, Ethan 2026-04-08.

Diego: sample PromQL for exporter noise: sum by(hour)(increase(alerts_fired_total{alertname=~"TelemetryExporter.*"}[30d])) - will upload CSV to the ticket.

Nina: threshold test plan: document metric baselines, create staging alerts, monitor FP% and MTTR. If FP% < 1.5% and MTTR stable, promote.

Ethan: dedupe prototype config (WIP):
```
- name: cross-az-dedupe
  signature_fields: ["service","error.class","stack_hash:8"]
  fingerprint: sha1
  window: 20m
```
Will include runbook entry for when dedupe masks a novel incident.

Maya: Add a recurring "Alert Quality Review" biweekly starting 2026-03-29 15:00 UTC. Ops-bot, add ticket links and owners.

ops-bot: Recurring meeting created and ticket INFR-4681 linked.

Diego: uploading CSV now.

Nina: I'll post proposed thresholds and staging metrics by EOD Friday.

Ethan: opening branch with dedupe prototype and RFC today.

Maya: Thanks all. I'll notify Support/PM about owners and timelines and follow up after the first review. :thumbsup:
